grade.summary: The proof correctly establishes termination via the strictly decreasing lexicographic measure (total number of prime factors counted with multiplicity, number of entries greater than 1). It then proves primewise invariance of the gcd of all valuations and reconstructs the unique terminal entry from these invariants. Both requested conclusions follow rigorously.
strengths: Correctly computes that a move decreases the total Ω-value by Ω(gcd(m,n)).
Handles the coprime case by showing the number of entries greater than 1 decreases.
Justifies that at least one entry greater than 1 remains after every move.
Correctly identifies the valuation transformation as (x,y) -> (min(x,y), |x-y|).
Correctly proves invariance of the gcd of each prime's valuation multiset and uses terminality to determine every valuation of M.
